svg.title: ESP-Drone iOS app
svg.desc: Screen map of the ESP-Drone iOS client: the landscape stick screen, the link picker, the flight commands, the Mission screen with read-only zones, the Plan (Mission Planner Flight Plan) screen, the Indoor Map annotation editor and the PID tuning screen. Bluetooth Classic SPP is not available on iOS.
svg.text: Fly landscape · Mission / Indoor Map / Tune portrait · iOS 15+ · WiFi and BLE GATT · Bluetooth Classic SPP unavailable
SPP is listed but cannot open: iOS only
exposes Bluetooth Classic to MFi accessories.
